content.key_idea: MGG loads a graph and GNN model, builds a GNN-tailored communication-computation pipeline and maps it onto GPU warps inside its Kernel & Runtime Manager, then iteratively tunes runtime parameters using performance feedback from the deployed multi-GPU platform.
content.reading_order: Left to right: graph/embedding/model inputs feed into MGG's loader and initializer, through the Kernel & Runtime Manager, out to the DGX platform, with a feedback loop back through the Runtime Parameter Optimizer.

summary: MGG accelerates graph neural network (GNN) computation on multi-GPU platforms through fine-grained intra-kernel communication-computation pipelining. This overview figure shows graph structure, node embedding, and GNN model inputs flowing into MGG's Graph Loader & Model Initializer, which works alongside an SHMEM library (e.g. NVSHMEM) to feed the Kernel & Runtime Manager, the system's core. That manager comprises two labeled subsystems: a GNN-tailored Pipeline Construct (with pipeline-aware workload management and hybrid data placement) and a GPU-aware Pipeline Mapping (with warp-based mapping/pipelining and specialized memory design). The optimized design is deployed to an NVIDIA DGX multi-GPU platform, whose performance feedback flows to a Runtime Param. Optimizer that refines runtime parameters and feeds them back into the Kernel & Runtime Manager, closing a tuning loop confirmed by the paper's description of monitoring latency and generating new configurations each iteration. The diagram is a dense, left-to-right flat architecture diagram with a dashed system boundary, nested labeled boxes, and a bitmap icon of the target GPU hardware.
summary_zh: 图为MGG系统概览：图结构、节点嵌入与GNN模型输入经加载器与SHMEM库进入核心运行时管理器，其中包含GNN定制流水线构建与GPU感知流水线映射两个子模块，优化后的设计部署到NVIDIA DGX多GPU平台，平台性能反馈驱动运行时参数优化器进行闭环调优。
